name: MW – Lists Sync for MC
author: Merav

sections.description:
Stop treating your customers like a monolith. If a customer buys a mountain bike, they probably don’t want your weekly newsletter about yoga mats. MW – Lists Sync for MC solves the “one-size-fits-all” marketing problem by creating a direct bridge between your WooCommerce product categories and your Mailchimp audiences.

When a customer places an order, this plugin checks what they bought and instantly adds them to the corresponding Mailchimp list. It’s the easiest way to ensure your marketing is relevant, personalized, and—most importantly—profitable.

Why use Category-Based Sync?

Most integrations just dump everyone into one “Master List.” This leads to high unsubscribe rates and low engagement. By segmenting customers at the moment of purchase, you can trigger automated welcome sequences that actually match their interests.

Freemium & Premium

The free version allows you to map up to 2 lists. For the premium version with unlimited mappings, contact us: info@meravwebs.com

Core Features

  • Automated Mapping: Link specific WooCommerce categories to specific Mailchimp lists.
  • Real-Time Sync: Data is sent to Mailchimp as soon as the order is processed.
  • Seamless Integration: Works quietly in the background without slowing down your checkout.
  • Precision Targeting: Perfect for stores with diverse product ranges (e.g., Clothing, Electronics, Home Decor).

External services

This plugin connects to an API to obtain the lists from your Mailchimp account, it’s needed to show the lists information in the settings.

It sends the customer information when a new order is placed and matched the settings.
This service is provided by “Mailchimp”: terms of use – https://mailchimp.com/legal/terms/, privacy policy – https://mailchimp.com/legal/prior-privacy-policy/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folders to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Mailchimp Sync.
  4. Enter your Mailchimp API Key.
  5. Start mapping your product categories to your Mailchimp lists!
sections.faq:
Does this work with multiple categories?

Yes! If a customer buys products from three different categories, they will be synced to the three corresponding Mailchimp lists you have mapped.

Do I need a Mailchimp API Key?

Yes. You can generate one for free within your Mailchimp account under Account > Extras > API Keys.

Does it sync guest checkouts?

Absolutely. As long as the customer provides an email address during checkout, the plugin will sync their data regardless of whether they have a registered account.
